sources.title: DiffusionGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: DiffusionGemma abandons the sequential, token-by-token process of typical autoregressive Large Language Models. Built on Gemma 4 and Gemini Diffusion research, it prioritizes unprecedented speed and parallel layout generation, unlocking novel workflows for developers building real-time interactive AI applications.
